title: GameFrame3D shared interface
description: Engineering owns this single source for public HTTP payloads and the Python generation boundary. No duplicated shared schema in web or pipeline.

engineering: root config, dependency locks and run entry point

POST /api/jobs.request: multipart/form-data: image optional PNG/JPEG/WebP file, prompt optional string; at least one nonempty input required
POST /api/jobs.response: 202 Job; 422 Error for empty/invalid input, 503 Error if generation capability unavailable. Never report generated success for a stub.

GET /api/jobs/{id}.response: 200 Job, 404 Error. Status is derived from job files and process liveness; do not introduce a workflow/state-machine framework.

GET /api/examples.response: 200 array of Example, discriminated by kind=input|scene. InputExample prepares generation; SceneExample opens a verified completed scene and is prerecorded. Retain source, license, license_url, attribution and changes visibly. Materials-owned catalog is source data; service derives this API shape. Do not copy provenance into another independently maintained store.

GET /api/health.response: 200 Health; service responsiveness and generation capability are separate booleans.

GET /artifacts/{job_id}/{file}.response: Artifact bytes. Only regular files within the selected job directory; reject traversal and symlink escapes. Embed materials in downloadable GLB.

GET /demo/{file}.response: Read-only materials asset bytes rooted in demo/. API image URLs resolve here; reject traversal and symlink escapes. No job or generation is implied by an input image.

x-python.call: generate(request: dict, output_dir: pathlib.Path, on_progress: Callable[[dict], None]) -> dict
x-python.request: GenerationRequest; image_path is absolute local input or null; prompt is a string (may be empty with image), at least one usable input is required. Job id is supplied by server. output_dir is an isolated job directory passed as the second function argument; config_path is explicit and nullable in request.
x-python.progress: Progress dict; callback stores a current observational snapshot, not a state machine. Phase is descriptive text, no shared enum beyond Job.status.
x-python.return: Result dict. artifacts values are relative URI-reference paths contained in output_dir. The server resolves these to /artifacts/{id}/ URLs for HTTP clients, retaining the same payload shape. original points to retained input for image jobs; null for text-only jobs.
x-python.failure: Raise an exception with a safe actionable message; leave evidence written so far in output_dir. HTTP adapter records failure and retains evidence. Success requires actual readable GLB and evidence.
x-python.config: Explicit YAML config file validated by Pydantic, selected by root CLI. Generation-specific configuration details owned by pipeline and passed explicitly as request.config_path (nullable); no secret in request snapshots or public evidence.
x-python.evidence: evidence artifact records actual model/provider, calls and IDs when available, sanitized inputs/outputs, changes applied, timings, usage and cost. Unknown cost is null with reason, never fabricated zero. Preserve pre/post correction artifacts and link them inside evidence. Geometry generation decisions must depend on current input.
x-python.camera: Return source-image camera in final GLB coordinates according to Camera. Pipeline owns conversion from Blender internal Z-up to exported glTF/GLB right-handed Y-up; position, target and up must undergo the same export coordinate conversion as the scene, exactly once. Viewer applies no Blender-to-glTF conversion. Perspective and orthographic are supported. Use null when unavailable; never substitute bbox-fit and claim it is the original camera.
x-python.internal_scene: Scene description internals belong to pipeline/: characters/props, transforms, pose joint targets, environment and camera. Cross-line consumers use only GenerationRequest, Progress and Result. Manifest may preserve internal details for evidence without obligating viewer parsing.
x-python.outputs: Publish actual generated scene.glb, preview.png and evidence; retain scene.blend and manifest when produced and expose their artifact paths, otherwise null. GLB and evidence are required for a successful Result. Fields specify semantic roles; implementations may use relative filenames appropriate to the job directory.
x-python.timing: New generate calls report measured numeric elapsed_seconds. Reused SceneExample may use null when historical timing is unavailable; viewer displays unknown.

fov_degrees.description: Vertical FOV for perspective; null for orthographic.

orthographic_height.description: Vertical world-space span in meters for orthographic; null for perspective.

aspect_ratio.description: Source-image width / height. Use this aspect for the source comparison viewport; letterbox as needed.

Camera.description: Source-image camera expressed in final exported GLB world coordinates: right-handed, +Y up, positions/target in meters. No post-load recentering or scaling may invalidate this camera. Null Result.camera means source-image camera unavailable; bbox-fit/reset must be labelled default view, not original view.

blend.description: Downloadable Blender project with packed assets when available; null if unavailable.

manifest.description: Generation-owned scene/run manifest download. Internal contents are not a second cross-line API.

elapsed_seconds.description: Measured current-run elapsed seconds. Null only when a reused prerecorded scene has no reliable historical timing; never fabricate zero.

InputExample.description: Candidate input only: selecting prepares image/prompt for POST /api/jobs; no generated scene or reconstruction claim.

SceneExample.description: A verified loadable completed scene. Retain attribution and explicitly identify reused prior work in description/changes. Never create one solely from a candidate input.

x-web.dependency: Engineering owns root package.json and package-lock.json. Pin three 0.185.1, install with npm ci. Package paths confirmed with npm pack --dry-run --json; actual browser compatibility still requires testing.
x-web.vendor_mount: GET /vendor/three/{file} serves only the installed node_modules/three package, read-only, with containment checks and correct JS/WASM MIME types. Do not expose other node_modules or project files.
x-web.camera_aspect: For image inputs, original decoded pixel width/height is authoritative. Generator derives Camera.aspect_ratio from that image; adapter validates agreement and viewer preserves the original aspect (letterboxes when needed). For prompt-only generation, Camera.aspect_ratio is the generated composition aspect.

x-demo.mapping: The materials handoff directory contents land under demo/materials/. Catalog file paths resolve relative to its parent; service derives InputExample image URLs under /demo/materials/. Preserve provenance in catalog and derive API presentation from it. Script exports land under demo/scripts/. Session evidence and chat remain outside the repository.
x-demo.scenes: demo/scenes/ stores materials-provided reusable GLBs and sanitized validation evidence. Source provenance and relative file mappings stay in the materials-owned catalog; original local evidence paths never enter the public catalog. Reused scene description must state prior generation and manual pose refinement; camera=null without a verified source-image camera.
